appIds.title: App IDs
appIds.description: Optional Steam app IDs to fetch directly (e.g. 730, 570). Combined with search/listing results, then capped by maxApps.

listing.title: Listing
listing.description: Optional storefront listing: topsellers, new, or specials. Empty string skips listing (unless appIds/search also empty — then topsellers is used).

maxApps.title: Max apps
maxApps.description: Maximum apps to resolve and fetch details for.

cc.title: Country code
cc.description: Steam store country/currency code (cc=), e.g. us, pl, de, gb.
